errors.evidence: The description omits crucial context from the chart's title, namely that the data is for the "SST-2" dataset, using a "clean-label" method with a "poison_rate: 5% (2.6% of total)". This information is essential for understanding the plot.

The description incorrectly states that the orange line ("random") increases to 0.6 for "excellent". The chart shows the orange line increases to approximately 0.6 at the x-axis label "beautiful", not "excellent". At "excellent", the value is approximately 0.7.
The description of the green line ("start") omits its highest peak. The line's maximum ASR value is approximately 0.92 at the trigger word "stunning", but this key feature is not mentioned.
When describing the green line, the text states it ends at around 0.85. The actual value shown in the plot for "beautifully" is closer to 0.89.
